headline: Cyberattack remotely defrosts supermarket refrigerators, targeting Danfoss controllers
summary: A cyberattack disabled supermarket refrigerators by remotely triggering automatic defrosting, reportedly targeting Danfoss refrigeration controllers. One outlet describes the attack as hitting supermarkets across Europe, while another reports it specifically struck multiple French supermarket chains.

claims.statement: A cyberattack caused supermarket refrigerators to defrost by remotely activating automatic defrosting.

sources.quote: 'Unprecedented' Cyberattack cripples supermarket fridges across Europe as hackers activate automatic defrosting
Attackers remotely defrosted refrigerators at multiple French supermarket chains overnight
